text:
Elena: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — answering the most asked timeline q's about the API perf work, Console dashboard changes, and Optimize cost tooling. i'll break down target windows and key blockers.
Sam: thanks! can you give concrete dates/quarters? :eyes:
Elena: sure — high level: API perf (latency improvements + batching defaults) -> beta mid-May, GA end of June. Console revamp (new per-route dashboards + rollout UI) -> beta late May, GA early July. Optimize (cost suggestions + quantization advisor) -> limited alpha in June, general availability targeted for Q3.
Maria: will there be API compatibility breaking changes for customers?
Elena: no breaking surface changes. defaults may change (e.g., batching enabled at smaller window sizes) but we'll ship as opt-in flags for 2 weeks then flip with a migration note. any breaking hooks will be opt-in until GA.
Raj: infra question — do we need capacity reserved for the beta traffic spike? any cross-region implications?
Ana: runtime note — the new KV cache eviction improves tail latencies but requires a small kernel update on some GPU types. we'll gate the kernel rollout by region; Dedicated pools will get a coordinated deploy two weeks after hosted.
Sam: can we get a canary plan for the API perf roll? who owns metrics/alerts?
Elena: SRE + Runtime will own the canary. target canary: 1% traffic for 48h then 10% for 24h. key metrics: p50/p95 token latency, error rate, token cost. Raj/ Ana — i'll add you to the canary doc.
Maria: Docs ask — when will changelog + migration guide be ready?
Maria: need at least 1 week before beta to finalize the guide.
Elena: planning to publish the beta announcement + migration doc on the public docs site one week before beta. Maria, i'll share the draft by next Tue.
Sam: Optimize alpha — what's the onboarding model? invite-only or open?
Elena: invite-only alpha (customer success + a few internal teams). we want real traffic patterns before opening wider. expect signups via a simple form and a short onboarding call.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime-kernel-update v2.1.0 -> staging at 1769127890. See /releases for details.
Raj: any regulatory/Private deployment differences? Private customers need extra testing window, right?
Elena: yes — Private/VPC installs will be scheduleable; we'll offer a 4-week testing window and a backout plan. Dedicated customers will be staggered after hosted stability.
Ana: small implementation detail — the batching default change will be behind `redwood.batch_v2` flag. SDKs will expose a toggle.
Sam: will SDKs be shipped in the same window?
Elena: SDK patches for the flag will be published with the beta. we won't change SDK semantics without explicit release notes.
Maria: adding note to docs backlog: migration checklist, config snippets, sample curl commands.
Elena: i'll follow up with a short RFC + timeline doc and a calendar invite for the working session this Thursday. thanks all — please drop any other Qs here and i'll update the doc. :tada:
